stories.title: China tightens export controls on tunnel‑boring machines, could affect Indian projects
stories.summary: China announced tighter export controls on tunnel‑boring machines and other specialised construction equipment. The move raises concerns that Indian infrastructure projects, especially those near the disputed Himalayan border, may face delays or higher costs. Analysts note that China's dominant position in this equipment market gives Beijing leverage over those projects.

stories.title: Heavily‑armed police begin patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach shooting
stories.summary: New South Wales police have deployed the Armed Response Command, sending specially trained officers with long‑arm rifles to patrol busy tourist areas, major sporting events and places of worship in Sydney. The deployment follows the December Bondi Beach attack in which two gunmen killed 15 people, including a 10‑year‑old girl, during a Hanukkah celebration. The shooting, Australia’s worst mass shooting in almost three decades, prompted sweeping gun‑law reforms and a crackdown on hate speech.
stories.why: The patrols are intended to deter and quickly respond to armed threats in high‑profile public spaces.

stories.title: OpenAI may rename data centers as “AI compute campuses”
stories.summary: Axios reports that OpenAI is considering rebranding its data centers as “AI compute campuses” and is planning a public‑relations push after the upcoming midterm elections, which are expected to shift control of Congress to Democrats. Chief global affairs officer Chris Lehane told Axios the midterms will act like a “movie trailer” for the role AI will play in the 2028 presidential election.
stories.why: The naming change could shape how OpenAI presents its infrastructure to policymakers and the public ahead of heightened political scrutiny.
